title: Retention guardrails and compliance ledger export for interactive request artifacts
creator: Aisha Kaur
description:
Summary: Implement a unified set of configurable guardrails for retention of prompts, responses, request logs, and derived metrics, plus a machine-readable compliance ledger export that can be attached to evidence bundles or legal-hold snapshots. This ticket scopes the product requirements, high-level UX, API contract, and acceptance criteria for the first phase (per-tenant and per-route policies + ledger export).

Problem statement: Customers in regulated industries need predictable controls to minimize PII surface while keeping forensic evidence for audits. Today we have ad-hoc TTLs and no standardized, exportable ledger that proves what data was retained/purged and why. That complicates audits and legal holds.

Goals (phase 1):
- Allow admins to set per-tenant default retention and override at route-level with an inheritance model.
- Support explicit modes: keep (retain until manual purge), ttl-based (days), and sampled (percentage + deterministic sampling seed).
- Generate an append-only compliance ledger (JSONL) that records retention decisions for every snapshot/purge/export operation. Ledger entries must include timestamp, route, tenant, artifact types (prompt/response/log/metric), retention_rule_id, action (retain/purge/snapshot/export), and content-hash references.
- Provide a Console preview UI that simulates retained vs evicted volumes for a given route/period, and a button to "Create evidence bundle" which packages the ledger + signed manifest + selected artifacts.
- Expose an API endpoint for on-demand snapshot exports and legal-hold toggles.

Non-goals: full data residency enforcement (handled by a separate project), cross-region archival policies in phase 1, encrypted HSM signing of exports (phase 1 uses service signing; HSM integration tracked separately).

API contract (high level):
- PUT /v1/tenants/{id}/retention-policy -> set tenant-level defaults. Fields: mode, ttl_days, sampling_rate, excluded_routes, allow_manual_snapshot.
- PUT /v1/routes/{id}/retention-policy -> per-route override, inherits missing fields from tenant.
- POST /v1/tenants/{id}/snapshot?legal_hold=true -> triggers evidence bundle creation and returns signed manifest URL.
- GET /v1/tenants/{id}/retention-preview?lookback_days=30 -> returns simulation summary (counts/tokens/estimated-cost).

Data model notes: retention_rule_id must be globally unique (uuid string). Ledger entry format is JSONL but the exact schema will be included in an internal spec doc linked below. Ledger entries will reference artifact storage paths instead of embedding content for evidence size control.

Security & compliance notes: ledger and manifest must be tamper-evident. For phase 1 we will HMAC-sign manifests with a service key (rotation policy to be documented). E2E HSM signing is planned but out of scope. Audit logs for policy changes must be retained for 7 years by default per compliance team guidance (configurable).
acceptance_criteria: Admins can create tenant-level retention policies with mode=keep|ttl|sampled
Route-level overrides apply with an explicit inheritance resolution endpoint
Console shows retention-preview simulation for a 30-day window with token counts and estimated storage cost
Snapshot API produces a downloadable evidence bundle with a machine-readable ledger (JSONL) and a signed manifest
Ledger entries include retention_rule_id, action, timestamp, tenant_id, route_id, artifact_type, content_hash, storage_path
Policy changes are recorded in the audit log with actor and timestamp
Documentation and developer API spec are published and linked in the PR
notes: 2026-03-02: RFC posted to #product-compliance for early feedback. Sizing estimate revised from 13 to 8 points after eng triage.
2026-03-04: Security flagged manifest signing must be tamper-evident; agreed on HMAC in phase 1, HSM planned for phase 2 (tracked in ENG-22456).
2026-03-06: Design provided two UX flows: (A) Route list with inline TTL overrides, and (B) Policy composition wizard. PM prefers (A) for faster delivery.

Trade-offs considered: deterministic sampling provides reproducibility but can bias retention distribution; alternate strategy is time-window sampling (more complex). Decided to support deterministic sampling seed as MVP.
Storage/cost considerations: retaining full artifacts for legal hold increases cost. We will offer sampled exports and manifest-only bundles as export options in the snapshot API.

If a tenant sets mode=keep, their data will remain until explicit purge; legal hold will lock purge operations for affected artifacts. Purge workflows will require an extra confirmation and an audit entry.
comments: Marco Diaz (assignee) - 2026-03-03: Starting backend spike to design ledger schema and retention_rule_id indexing. Will share prototype schema by 2026-03-07.
Lina Chen (Design) - 2026-03-05: UX suggestion: add an "inheritance trace" on route policy detail so admins can see why a value was inherited. Captured in mockups.

Jonah Patel (Engineering) - 2026-03-08: Need clarification on whether metrics-derived artifacts are treated as first-class artifacts or summarized. Proposal: keep metrics summaries (counts and aggregates) and do not retain raw telemetry in evidence bundles unless requested.
Compliance (review) - 2026-03-09: Confirmed ledger content-hash + storage_path meets auditability requirements; request adding a chain-of-custody field to manifest (who exported, export_job_id).
Aisha Kaur (creator) - 2026-03-10: Updated acceptance criteria to require signed manifest and published API spec. Added release target console-2026.04.
